user_confirmation: Same electrode/setup conditions as EMG009, but re-worn; no gel per prior confirmation; CH1-6 wrist and CH7-8 near elbow

model_within_rewear_grouped_cv.name: EMG010 within-rewear grouped 5-fold validation
model_within_rewear_grouped_cv.contract: same 100 ms/25 ms feature windows; GroupKFold splits entire labeled segments, so a segment never appears in both train and test

model_rewear.name: EMG009 train -> EMG010 test (rewear)
model_rewear.contract: tools/train_baseline.py features MAV/WL/Energy/ZC/SSC, 8 channels; 100 ms/25 ms; StandardScaler + MLP(64,32)

model_two_capture_rewear.name: EMG008+EMG009 train -> EMG010 test (rewear, two prior captures)
model_two_capture_rewear.contract: tools/train_baseline.py features MAV/WL/Energy/ZC/SSC, 8 channels; 100 ms/25 ms; StandardScaler + MLP(64,32)

method.psd: Welch 4096, 50% overlap, linear detrend; duration-weighted stable segments
method.model: five random initializations; rest balanced to median movement windows
method.caveat: 25 ms hop means adjacent 100 ms evaluation windows overlap 75%; bouts, not windows, are the independent repeats here.
